Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator first proposed the incorrect class composition (“Demon Hunter, Druid, Mage, Paladin, Priest”), which violates multiple constraints: it fails the “two plate, two cloth” requirement (resulting in 1 plate, 2 cloth, 2 leather), misassigns Metamorphosis to a Demon Hunter instead of a Warlock (which also disrupts the armor distribution and timeframe implied by the drop), misinterprets the “bear attacking” as a Druid rather than a Hunter’s bear pet, and misidentifies the Kilt of the Forgotten One’s armor type (treating it as mail rather than leather). This faulty synthesis led directly to the wrong final answer.
